title: Backend & API Development
description: Design and build backends that hold up at very high scale: REST endpoints and OpenAPI specs with capacity planning to a million requests per second, versioning, pagination, errors, GraphQL and gRPC schemas and evolution, JWT, OAuth2/OIDC, cookies, RBAC, API keys and passkeys, Kafka, RabbitMQ, job queues, Celery, outbox and idempotency, Redis caching and connection pools, resilient third-party integrations, webhooks and Stripe, WebSockets and SSE, and serverless functions and workflows.
